status: a=1 dominance SURVIVES to n=1000; Delta k in {1,2} throughout; no kill criterion fired
certificate_notes: per_layer stores reduced-precision measurements (≈12 sig figs) for repo size. Exact integers: n,k,dk,argmax_a. Exact x_n = 2^(k-1)/3^n is recovered in tests, not stored. Full-precision re-run: ODOM_MODE=run then analyze (requires mpmath). Summary blocks (part2/part3/stability/kill) preserved from the original analyze.

precision.dps_guidance_per_layer: 0.6*n + 60 (main-run dps exceeds this at every layer)
precision.label: ALL magnitudes/weights/deltas/fits are measurements at the stated dps; k(n), dk, x_n, a-tail bounds are exact

kill_criteria.K1: any layer with argmax_a w_a != 1 or non-unique max
kill_criteria.K2: k(n) non-monotone or Delta k not in {1,2}

transient_deviations_n_lt_100.note: decaying transient, x0.85/layer, gone by n ~ 100; window-independent conclusions are drawn from n >= 100 agreement plus the n = 6..21 exact-certificate cross-checks

windows.exponent_window: k in [-750, floor(2.2n)+30); FIXED bottom (see module docstring for why the bottom must not recede)

part2_drift.delta_definition: delta(n) = n*log2(3) - k(n) (log2(3) from 60-digit exact-integer series; fit in float64: measurement)

part3_logic.rho_definition: rho_n = |c_{n-1}[k(n)-1]| / M_{n-1} (measurement); on dk=1 layers rho = 1 identically since k(n)-1 = k(n-1) is the previous argmax

background_decay_left_band.definition: max |c_n[k]| over the clean band [L+100, L+103) relative to layer peak; the non-resonant background decays ~3^(-n/2), much faster than M_n ~ e^(-1.06 sqrt n), so the peak separates exponentially
